articles.summary: Highlights GLDY can now be bought through a traditional brokerage account. Siebert brokers will now offer GLDY to their clients the same way they would any stock or bond, no blockchain knowledge required. Investors simply work with their Siebert broker to add GLDY to their portfolio.
articles.title: Streamex Corp. Brings Yield-Bearing Gold (GLDY) to Traditional Brokerage Accounts Through Collaboration with Siebert Financial and tZERO
